pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:1.2: tena kho pana samayena Sāvatthiyā avidūre aññatarassa pūgassa āvasathapiṇḍo paññatto hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:1.3: chabbaggiyā bhikkhū pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya Sāvatthiṃ piṇḍāya pavisitvā piṇḍaṃ alabhamānā āvasathaṃ agamaṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:1.4: manussā cirassāpi bhaddantā āgatā 'ti sakkaccaṃ parivisiṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:1.5: atha kho chabbaggiyā bhikkhū dutiyam pi divasaṃ --pa-- tatiyam pi divasaṃ pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā . . . āvasathaṃ gantvā bhuñjiṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:1.6: atha kho chabbaggiyānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etad ahosi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:1.8: hiyyo pi idh' eva āgantabbaṃ bhavissatīti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:1.9: tatth' eva anuvasitvā anuvasitvā āvasathapiṇḍaṃ bhuñjanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:1.12: kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā anuvasitvā anuvasitvā āvasathapiṇḍaṃ bhuñjissanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:1.15: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ . . . vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:1.17: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū anuvasitvā anuvasitvā āvasathapiṇḍaṃ bhuñjissantīti --pa--.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:1.21: kathañ hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā . . . bhuñjissatha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:1.24.1: eko āvasathapiṇḍo bhuñjitabbo. tato ce uttari bhuñjeyya, pācittiyan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:1.25: evañ c' idaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:2.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Sāriputto Kosalesu janapadesu Sāvatthiṃ gacchanto yena aññataro āvasatho ten' upasaṃkami.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:2.2: manussā cirassāpi thero āgato 'ti sakkaccaṃ parivisiṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:2.3: atha kho āyasmato Sāriputtassa bhuttāvissa kharo ābādho uppajji, nāsakkhi tamhā āvasathā pakkamituṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:2.4: atha kho te manussā dutiyam pi divasaṃ āyasmantaṃ Sāriputtaṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:2.7: bhagavatā paṭikkhittaṃ anuvasitvā anuvasitvā āvasathapiṇḍaṃ bhuñjitun ti kukkuccāyanto na paṭiggahesi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:2.9: atha kho āyasmā Sāriputto Sāvatthiṃ gantvā bhikkhūnaṃ etam atthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:2.11: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:2.12: anujānāmi bhikkhave gilānena bhikkhunā anuvasitvā anuvasitvā āvasathapiṇḍaṃ bhuñjituṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:2.13: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:2.14.1: agilānena bhikkhunā eko āvasathapiṇḍo bhuñjitabbo. tato ce uttari bhuñjeyya, pācittiyan ti. ||2||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:3.1.6: pañcannaṃ bhojanānaṃ aññataraṃ bhojanaṃ sālāyaṃ vā maṇḍape vā rukkhamūle vā ajjhokāse vā anodissa yāvadattho paññatto hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:3.1.7: agilānena bhikkhunā sakiṃ bhuñjitabbo. tato ce uttari bhuñjissāmīti paṭigaṇhāti, āpatti dukkaṭassa,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:3.2.1: agilāno agilānasaññī tat' uttari āvasathapiṇḍaṃ bhuñjati, āpatti pācittiyassa.
